subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord keep this bounded channel-level retry as defense in depth if the shared reply-session self-heal also lands?
rationale: Both changes address the same conflict at different ownership layers, and only maintainers can decide the permanent division between channel recovery and shared session lifecycle policy.

options.title: Keep bounded Discord defense
options.body: Land this narrow retry and retain it after shared recovery as a transport-level safeguard with bounded delays and replay-safe exhaustion.

options.title: Consolidate into shared recovery
options.body: Pause this PR and require the shared session fix to fully own recovery, adding Discord-specific proof there before closing this candidate.

recommendation.title: Keep bounded Discord defense
recommendation.body: Land this narrow retry and retain it after shared recovery as a transport-level safeguard with bounded delays and replay-safe exhaustion.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the PR and has recent history across both the Discord handler and adjacent session lifecycle work.
